{{nihongo|'''Sumetaruho Yoshida-ōkamigū'''|皇足穂吉田大御神宮}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Shinano Province]].

'''Sumetaruo Yoshida Ōmikamigū''' (すめたるほよしだおおみかみぐう) is a {{ill|Shinto shrine|Q845945|qid=Q845945}} (a {{ill|Son-sha|Q134917284|qid=Q134917284}}) located in {{ill|Yoshida|ja|吉田 (長野市)|qid=Q11413505|lt=Yoshida}} 1-chōme, {{ill|Nagano (city)|af|Nagano|an|Nagano|ar|ناغانو (ناغانو)|arz|ناجانو|ast|Nagano|az|Naqano|azb|ناقانو (شهر)|ba|Нагано|ban|Nagano, Nagano|be|Нагана|bg|Нагано (град)|bn|নাগানো|br|Nagano|ca|Nagano|ce|Нагано|ceb|Nagano Shi|cs|Nagano|da|Nagano|de|Nagano|el|Ναγκάνο|eo|Nagano|es|Nagano|et|Nagano|eu|Nagano|fa|ناگانو (شهر)|fi|Nagano|fo|Nagano|fr|Nagano|fy|Nagano (stêd)|ga|Nagano|gl|Nagano|he|נאגנו|hr|Nagano|hu|Nagano|hy|Նագանո|id|Nagano|ie|Nagano|io|Nagano|it|Nagano|ja|長野市|ka|ნაგანო (ქალაქი)|kk|Нагано|ko|나가노시|ky|Нагано|lt|Naganas|lv|Nagano|mdf|Нагана (ошсь)|mn|Нагано|mr|नागानो|mzn|ناگانو (شهر)|nl|Nagano (stad)|nn|Nagano|no|Nagano|os|Нагано|pcd|Nagano|pl|Nagano|pt|Nagano (cidade)|qu|Nagano|ro|Nagano|ru|Нагано|sc|Nagano|sco|Nagano, Nagano|sh|Nagano|simple|Nagano (city)|sk|Nagano|sl|Nagano|sr|Нагано|sv|Nagano|sw|Nagano, Nagano|szl|Nagano|tg|Нагано|th|นางาโนะ (เมือง)|tl|Lungsod ng Nagano|tr|Nagano|tt|Нагано|uk|Нагано|ur|ناگانو، ناگانو|uz|Nagano|vi|Nagano (thành phố)|war|Nagano (syudad)|wuu|长野市|zh|長野市|zh_classical|長野市|zh_min_nan|Nagano-chhī|zh_yue|長野市|qid=Q128849}}, {{ill|Nagano Prefecture|Q127877|qid=Q127877}}. It is commonly known as '''Yoshida Shrine'''.

=== Overview ===
As its name appears in the shrine register (Jinmyōchō) of the {{ill|Engishiki|ar|إنجيشيكي (كتاب ياباني)|de|Engishiki|es|Engishiki|fr|Engishiki|he|אנגישיקי|id|Engishiki|it|Engishiki|ja|延喜式|ko|엔기시키|min|Engishiki|mr|इंगिशिकी|nl|Engishiki|pt|Engishiki|ru|Энгисики|simple|Engishiki|tr|Engishiki|uk|Енґісікі|zh|延喜式|qid=Q1342448}} from {{ill|927|Q30470|qid=Q30470}} ({{ill|Enchō|Q1327274|qid=Q1327274|lt=Enchō}} 5), the shrine has a long history.

Originally, it was enshrined about 1 km to the east in Komachi (present-day {{ill|Yoshida|ja|吉田 (長野市)|qid=Q11413505|lt=Yoshida}} 3-chōme). However, because the area was frequently flooded by the {{ill|Asa River|ceb|Asa Kawa (suba sa Hapon, Nagano-ken)|ja|浅川 (長野県)|qid=Q11557083|lt=Asakawa}} and because the {{ill|Hokkoku Kaidō|Q3069767|qid=Q3069767|lt=Hokkoku Kaidō}} was newly developed, the shrine was relocated during the {{ill|Keichō|Q1328185|qid=Q1328185}} era to its current site along the Hokkoku Kaidō (Uemachi, present-day Yoshida 1-chōme).<ref name="weekly-nagano">[http://weekly-nagano.main.jp/2010/06/97.html 097 Yoshida Shrine—The lively precincts during the Festival of the Gods] - Weekly Nagano</ref> At the time of this relocation, nearby shrines were consolidated, resulting in the unusual configuration of approximately 100 auxiliary shrines of various sizes within the precincts.<ref name="weekly-nagano" />

The sacred {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=goshinboku}} {{ill|Ginkgo biloba|af|Ginkgo|ar|جنكة بيلوبا|arz|جنكه بيلوبا|ast|Ginkgo biloba|az|İkidilim ginkqo|ban|Ginkgo biloba|bcl|Ginkgo biloba|be|Гінкга|be_x_old|Гінкга двухлопасьцевы|bg|Гинко билоба|br|Ginkgo biloba|ca|Ginkgo biloba|ceb|Ginkgo biloba|cs|Jinan dvoulaločný|cy|Coeden ginco|da|Tempeltræ|de|Ginkgo|dsb|Rozdwójony ginkgo|el|Γκίγκο|es|Ginkgo biloba|et|Hõlmikpuu|eu|Ginkgo|fa|کهن‌دار|fi|Neidonhiuspuu|fiu_vro|Hõlmikpuu|fr|Ginkgo biloba|frr|Ginkgo biloba|gl|Xinkgo|haw|Nanahana|he|גינקו דו-אונתי|hi|जिन्को बाइलोबा|hr|Dvorežnjasti ginko|hsb|Rozdwojeny ginkgo|hu|Páfrányfenyő|hy|Գինկգո|hyw|Ճինքկօ|id|Ginkgo biloba|is|Musteristré|it|Ginkgo biloba|ja|イチョウ|jv|Ginkgo biloba|kn|ಗಿಂಕ್ಗೊ ಬಿಲೋಬ|ko|은행나무|koi|Гинкго|kv|Гинкго|la|Ginkgo biloba|lb|Ginkgo|lfn|Ginco|li|Ginkgo|lmo|Ginkgo biloba|lt|Dviskiautis ginkmedis|lv|Divdaivu ginks|mk|Гинко|ml|ജിൻകോ ബൈലൊബ|mrj|Гинкго|ms|Ginkgo biloba|nl|Japanse notenboom|nn|Tempeltre|no|Tempeltre|oc|Ginkgo biloba|pa|ਗਿੰਕਗੋ|pl|Miłorząb dwuklapowy|pms|Ginkgo biloba|pnb|گنکگو|ps|جينکگو بيلوبا|pt|Ginkgo biloba|ro|Arborele pagodelor|roa_tara|Ginkgo biloba|ru|Гинкго двулопастной|sco|Ginkgo biloba|sh|Ginko|si|Ginkgo biloba|sk|Ginko dvojlaločné|sl|Dvokrpi ginko|sr|Гинко|sv|Ginkgo|szy|nipaluma-insin|ta|பாசில் மரம்|te|గిన్‌కోగో వృక్షం|th|แปะก๊วย|tl|Ginkgo biloba|tr|Mabet ağacı|udm|Гинкго|uk|Ґінкго дволопатеве|uz|Ginkgo|vi|Bạch quả|war|Ginkgo biloba|wuu|银杏|zh|银杏|zh_min_nan|Gîn-hēng|zh_yue|白果|qid=Q43284}} (described below) that stood at the former site was left in place even after the relocation and remains vigorous to this day.

=== The Yoshida Ginkgo ===
The {{ill|Ginkgo biloba|af|Ginkgo|ar|جنكة بيلوبا|arz|جنكه بيلوبا|ast|Ginkgo biloba|az|İkidilim ginkqo|ban|Ginkgo biloba|bcl|Ginkgo biloba|be|Гінкга|be_x_old|Гінкга двухлопасьцевы|bg|Гинко билоба|br|Ginkgo biloba|ca|Ginkgo biloba|ceb|Ginkgo biloba|cs|Jinan dvoulaločný|cy|Coeden ginco|da|Tempeltræ|de|Ginkgo|dsb|Rozdwójony ginkgo|el|Γκίγκο|es|Ginkgo biloba|et|Hõlmikpuu|eu|Ginkgo|fa|کهن‌دار|fi|Neidonhiuspuu|fiu_vro|Hõlmikpuu|fr|Ginkgo biloba|frr|Ginkgo biloba|gl|Xinkgo|haw|Nanahana|he|גינקו דו-אונתי|hi|जिन्को बाइलोबा|hr|Dvorežnjasti ginko|hsb|Rozdwojeny ginkgo|hu|Páfrányfenyő|hy|Գինկգո|hyw|Ճինքկօ|id|Ginkgo biloba|is|Musteristré|it|Ginkgo biloba|ja|イチョウ|jv|Ginkgo biloba|kn|ಗಿಂಕ್ಗೊ ಬಿಲೋಬ|ko|은행나무|koi|Гинкго|kv|Гинкго|la|Ginkgo biloba|lb|Ginkgo|lfn|Ginco|li|Ginkgo|lmo|Ginkgo biloba|lt|Dviskiautis ginkmedis|lv|Divdaivu ginks|mk|Гинко|ml|ജിൻകോ ബൈലൊബ|mrj|Гинкго|ms|Ginkgo biloba|nl|Japanse notenboom|nn|Tempeltre|no|Tempeltre|oc|Ginkgo biloba|pa|ਗਿੰਕਗੋ|pl|Miłorząb dwuklapowy|pms|Ginkgo biloba|pnb|گنکگو|ps|جينکگو بيلوبا|pt|Ginkgo biloba|ro|Arborele pagodelor|roa_tara|Ginkgo biloba|ru|Гинкго двулопастной|sco|Ginkgo biloba|sh|Ginko|si|Ginkgo biloba|sk|Ginko dvojlaločné|sl|Dvokrpi ginko|sr|Гинко|sv|Ginkgo|szy|nipaluma-insin|ta|பாசில் மரம்|te|గిన్‌కోగో వృక్షం|th|แปะก๊วย|tl|Ginkgo biloba|tr|Mabet ağacı|udm|Гинкго|uk|Ґінкго дволопатеве|uz|Ginkgo|vi|Bạch quả|war|Ginkgo biloba|wuu|银杏|zh|银杏|zh_min_nan|Gîn-hēng|zh_yue|白果|qid=Q43284}} tree that still remains at the former shrine site is estimated to be 900 years old, with a height of 32 m, a trunk circumference at eye level of 8.6 m, and a branch spread of 11–15 m—an enormous tree.<ref name="city">[http://www.city.nagano.nagano.jp/uploaded/attachment/5599.pdf Yoshida Ginkgo　Ginkgo tree in Yoshida] - Cultural Properties Division, Board of Education, Nagano City</ref> Before World War II it was designated a {{ill|Natural monument|Q23790|qid=Q23790}} of Nagano Prefecture, and it is currently designated a Natural Monument of Nagano City.

It is a male tree and does not bear fruit, but according to legend, if its bark is soaked in water and the water is given to a mother to drink, her {{ill|Breast milk|ar|حليب الثدي|ast|Lleche materno|az|Ana südü|be|Жаночае малако|be_x_old|Жаночае малако|bg|Кърма|bn|বুকের দুধ|bs|Majčino mlijeko|ca|Llet materna|ckb|شیری دایک|cs|Mateřské mléko|cy|Llaeth y fron|da|Modermælk|de|Muttermilch|diq|Şıtê mae|dv|ހޯމޯން ކިރުގެ ޙުކުމް އިސްލާމީ ނަޒަރަކުން|el|Μητρικό γάλα|eo|Patrina lakto|es|Leche materna|et|Rinnapiim|eu|Ama-esne|fa|شیر مادر|fi|Äidinmaito|fr|Lait maternel humain|ga|Bainne cíche|gl|Leite humano|he|חלב אם|hi|मां का दूध|hu|Anyatej|hy|Կրծքի կաթ|hyw|Կուրծքի Կաթը|id|Air susu ibu|ilo|Gatas ti suso|it|Latte materno|ja|母乳|jv|Banyu susu ibu|ko|모유|ky|Эмчек сүтү|lb|Spënn|lt|Motinos pienas|ml|മുലപ്പാൽ|ms|Susu ibu|nds|Tittmelk|ne|आमाको दूध|nl|Moedermelk|no|Morsmelk|pa|ਮਾਂ ਦਾ ਦੁੱਧ|pfl|Muttermilch|pt|Leite materno|qu|Ñukñu|ro|Lapte matern|ru|Женское молоко|sk|Materské mlieko|sl|Materino mleko|sr|Мајчино млеко|su|Cai Susu Indung|sv|Bröstmjölk|sw|Maziwa ya mama|ta|தாய்ப்பால்|te|తల్లిపాలు|th|นมจากเต้านม|tk|Ene süýdi|tn|Mashi a lebele|tr|Anne sütü|ug|ئانا سۈتى|uk|Грудне молоко|ur|ماں کا دودھ|uz|Ona suti|vi|Sữa mẹ|war|Gatas han iroy|wuu|母乳|zh|母乳|zh_yue|人奶|qid=Q22728}} will flow. For this reason, it is called the “Milk Ginkgo.”<ref name="city" />

=== History ===

; Current site
* 3-minute walk from {{ill|Kirihara Station (Nagano)|ja|桐原駅 (長野県)|zh|桐原站 (長野縣)|qid=Q11537186|lt=Kirihara Station}} on the {{ill|Nagano Electric Railway|Q6958437|qid=Q6958437}}

* 5-minute walk from {{ill|Kita-Nagano Station|Q6417571|qid=Q6417571}} on the {{ill|Shinano Railway|Q11254401|qid=Q11254401}}
